About the Team

Hello! I am a solo participant from Tanzania passionate about space storytelling. I chose "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars".I love Writing & Communications, Arts & Multimedia, Graphic Design, and Web Development. I will build an interactive storytelling website that brings abandoned NASA equipment to life with short stories, pictures, and fun facts for young people. Beginner but very motivated to learn.
